{{Quote|You got this shipment from the ''Demoneye'' out of Ventooine. It picked up the shipment from the Bosph system.|[[Mander Zuma]], to Threnda|<ref name="Scourge (novel)" />}}
The '''''Demoneye''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Scourge (novel)" /> In about [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']] to [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].</ref> the ''Demoneye'' traveled from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ventooine/Legends|Ventooine]] to collect a shipment of the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]] from the [[Bosph system/Legends|Bosph system]], and some of the spice was eventually received by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Threnda]] on the world [[Budpock]].<ref name="Scourge (novel)" />
